chapter.title: Time
chapter.para: JetOS keeps the time of the module and gives it to the scheduler and to the partitions.

section.para: JetOS shall maintain a system time, in nanoseconds since the start of the module, that never decreases.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The time windows of the partitions, the time-outs and the periods of the processes are all measured against one clock.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_BSP_READ_CNTVCT_01 HLR_BSP_READ_CNTFRQ_01 HLR_BSP_JA_SYSTEM_TIME_01 HLR_PIT_READ_TSC_01 HLR_PIT_CALIBRATE_TSC_01 HLR_PIT_JA_SYSTEM_TIME_01

section.para: JetOS shall give the system time to a partition that asks for the time of the real-time clock.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The partition library builds its time services on the system time; no other clock exists in the module.

section.para: JetOS shall refuse with an error a request of a partition for the time of any other clock.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: No other clock exists in the module.

section.para: JetOS shall give the calendar time, in seconds, to a partition that asks for it: the calendar time read at the start of the module plus the system time.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Partitions need the date for logs and time stamps, and it has to advance with the system time.

section.para: JetOS shall re-evaluate its scheduling decisions at every tick of a periodic timer of the board, whose frequency is fixed when JetOS is built.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The ends of the time windows and the time-outs take effect within one tick period of their time.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_BSP_WRITE_CNTV_CVAL_01 HLR_BSP_WRITE_CNTV_CTL_01 HLR_BSP_READ_CNTV_CTL_01 HLR_BSP_TIMER_INIT_01 HLR_BSP_SET_NEXT_TICK_01 HLR_BSP_JA_BSP_PROCESS_IRQ_02 HLR_PIT_JA_BSP_PROCESS_TIMER_01 HLR_PIT_POK_X86_QEMU_TIMER_INIT_01 HLR_SCHED_POK_SCHED_ON_TIME_CHANGED_01 HLR_TIME_JET_ON_TICK_01

section.para: JetOS shall let the kernel and the partitions arrange for something to happen at a time (a time-out, a release, a deadline).

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: All time-related services are built on such delayed events.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_DELAYED_EVENT_DELAYED_EVENT_QUEUE_INIT_01 HLR_DELAYED_EVENT_DELAYED_EVENT_INIT_01 HLR_DELAYED_EVENT_DELAYED_EVENT_ADD_01 HLR_DELAYED_EVENT_DELAYED_EVENT_ADD_02 HLR_DELAYED_EVENT_DELAYED_EVENT_REMOVE_01 HLR_THREAD_INTERNAL_THREAD_DELAY_EVENT_01 HLR_THREAD_INTERNAL_THREAD_DELAY_EVENT_CANCEL_01 HLR_THREAD_INTERNAL_THREAD_WAIT_TIMED_01

section.para: JetOS shall make what was arranged for a time happen at that time or later, never before, in the order of the times.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A time-out or a release that came early would break the timing of the application.

section.para: JetOS shall take the calendar time at the start of the module from the real-time clock of the board if the board has one, and from a fixed date if it has not.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The calendar time has to come from somewhere at the start.
